Body.Content:
This feature lets you:

View continuous, multiday booking as blocks of booking for the daily/weekly/monthly view set on the schedule board.

Select partial booking on the schedule board.

Get cancel and delete options for complete booking and partial booking.

Business Value:

The partial booking modification feature lets resource managers cancel specific portions of a resource booking without deleting and recreating it. This reduces manual effort, improves scheduling accuracy, preserves audit history, and unlocks partially available capacity. The result is more flexible planning, higher usage, and better support for agile, real-world project delivery.

Enabled for:

Enabled for end users automatically

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: September CY2026
